normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private heated pool *Pool heating is available October 1-May 1 for $25 per day- Private courtyard- Access to 4 neighborhood pools- Access to fitness center and racquet club- 800 square feet of outdoor space- Professionally decorated- Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- 5 adult bikes- Carriage house- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Located just steps from the beautiful beaches in Rosemary, Mozell Cottage is a 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home that sleeps 14 guests. With white stucco, a private pool, a carriage house, and over 800 square feet of outdoor space, there is plenty of privacy and space to sunbathe and enjoy the sea breeze. Inside, modern and sophisticated artwork fill every room for a coastal, elegant feel. The first floor has access to the courtyard and pool, leading into 3 guest rooms. The first is a master suite with an en-suite bathroom and soaking tub. The other 2 both feature queen beds and private bathrooms. The second floor is the home's main level and features an open kitchen and living room, tied together by plenty of natural light that shines from the porch and 2 swanky light fixtures over the dining table and living area. The chef's kitchen has premium, stainless steel appliances, a waterfall island with marble countertops, and seating for 12 at the bar and dining table. French doors open up to a sprawling balcony overlooking the courtyard and pool, providing soft sunlight and a bed swing for the perfect spot to read a book or sip coffee in the morning. Upstairs, you'll find a cozy loft with a king bed, twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a seating area with a private bathroom. The home also features a carriage house across the courtyard for guests that are looking for more privacy. There is a living room with a full-sized sleeper sofa, a flat-screen TV, a private balcony, a dining table, and a kitchen with full-size appliances. There is also a bedroom with a king bed, flat-screen TV, and en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower. Guests renting the carriage house and main house will have access to 4 additional neighborhood pools, fitness center, racquet club, and 5 adult bikes. Don't miss your chance to vacation at this fabulous home and book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR LOFT:Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyLiving area: Full Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home.
